heading: Membership for Taiwan in Fund
lead: It is the sense of the Congress that it is the policy of the United States that Taiwan (before January 1, 1979, known as the Republic of China) shall be granted appropriate membership in the Fund and that the United States Executive Director of the Fund shall so notify the Fund.

notes.heading: Effective Date
notes.text: Section effective Oct. 7, 1980, see section 12 of Pub. L. 96–389, set out as a note under section 286s of this title.

notes.heading: Taiwan Non-Discrimination Act of 2025
notes.text: Pub. L. 119–60, div. H, title LXXXIII, subtitle A, Dec. 18, 2025, 139 Stat. 1851, provided that: “SEC. 8301. SHORT TITLE.“This subtitle may be cited as the ‘Taiwan Non-Discrimination Act of 2025’. “SEC. 8302.
